summary.zh-CN: 明确希望玩家获得的体验，并把目标转化为可讨论的设计问题。
summary.en: Frame intended player experiences as design questions that a team can discuss.

summary.zh-CN: 组织行动、规则、反馈与挑战，形成可理解且可持续的游玩过程。
summary.en: Organize actions, rules, feedback, and challenge into a legible play experience.

summary.zh-CN: 协调故事、世界、角色与玩家行动之间的关系。
summary.en: Coordinate story, world, characters, and player action.

summary.zh-CN: 让视觉、声音、文字与交互表现共同服务体验意图。
summary.en: Align visual, audio, verbal, and interactive expression with the intended experience.

summary.zh-CN: 把设计意图拆解成团队能够实现、检查与调整的工作。
summary.en: Turn design intent into work a team can implement, inspect, and revise.

summary.zh-CN: 通过原型、观察与反馈检验判断，并持续修正设计。
summary.en: Test design judgments through prototypes, observation, and feedback.

summary.zh-CN: 在跨职能团队中建立共同理解、做出取舍并推进决策。
summary.en: Build shared understanding and advance decisions across disciplines.

summary.zh-CN: 理解受众、定位与约束如何影响产品选择。
summary.en: Understand how audiences, positioning, and constraints shape product choices.

summary.zh-CN: 带着证据理解游戏形式如何出现、传播、融合与变化。
summary.en: Use evidence to understand how game forms emerge, spread, combine, and change.
